sloka: मांसादानि च सत्त्वानि रक्षांसि सुमहान्ति च ।अनुजग्मुर्हि भरतं रुधिरस्य पिपासया ।। ७.१००.२२ ॥
transliteration: māṁsādāni ca sattvāni rakṣāṁsi sumahānti ca ।anujagmurhi bharataṁ rudhirasya pipāsayā ।। 7.100.22 ॥

translations.english: Indeed, flesh-eating creatures and very great Rakshasas followed Bharata, driven by a thirst for blood.
